Sr. Business Development Manager at VMware, working with the world's leading cloud providers including Microsoft, Google, and Oracle. He was building Bitnami for many years before the acquisition by VMware.

Worked in software and with Open Source for over 15+ years as a developer, team leader, architect, building Web Applications, SaaS and Cloud Computing automation. Most of his professional career in startup, helping to scale from a few to a hundred. Digital nomad, more than 10+ years of working remotely.
